description: This file defines the AuthRepository class responsible for managing user authentication state, including sign-in and sign-out operations, within the Harmony music player's mobile frontend.

classes.name: AuthRepository
classes.description: Class managing user authentication state, with methods for signing in and signing out users.

methods.name: signIn
methods.description: Suspends and performs user sign-in operation; currently a placeholder that creates a dummy User object and updates the currentUser flow.

methods.name: signOut
methods.description: Suspends and clears the current user, effectively signing the user out.
